summary: All 33 source files matched their recorded SHA-256 and size. All 107 registered pairs agreed in direction, covering 81.06% of the 132 selected S1 effects. The proposal overstated the reconstruction: 13 additional candidate loci could be checked from deposited counts. Eleven matched, while CXCL1 and CXCL3 each yielded the value printed for the other gene. The corrected proposal retains `compared` for the selected effects and keeps the detailed review `unresolved`. It passed the proposal validator.
openIssues: GSM1201496 was the only single-control omission that recovered the published gene count. The paper gives no sample-level exclusion record, and neither Table 1 mean reconciles under that omission.
The authors’ original stable identifiers for CXCL1 and CXCL3 remain unknown.
Twenty-five S1 effects lack a supported registered pair. Numeric author P values and adjusted P values remain unavailable.
